display_long_description:
**Adiona-G Driving Simulator** is an immersive virtual reality and augmented reality driver safety training experience designed to demonstrate the real-world consequences of unsafe driving behaviors.

The simulator places users behind the wheel in realistic scenarios that demonstrate the dangers of intoxicated driving **(DUI/DWI), marijuana (THC) impairment**, and **distracted driving**, including **texting while driving** and mobile phone interaction. Participants experience how alcohol and THC impairment affect reaction time, steering control, peripheral vision, hazard detection, decision-making, and visual attention, including attention drift away from the roadway toward distractions. The program also illustrates how texting and driving, even for a few seconds, can lead to lane drift, delayed braking, missed hazards, and collisions.

Adiona-G supports both left- and right-hand traffic, with adjustable driver position. All impaired driving simulations are included with every license. Organizations can display sponsor or safety messaging before a session.

Adiona-G is designed strictly for education and prevention — it demonstrates how quickly control deteriorates under alcohol or THC or while engaged in phone distraction.

Developed by a company with over 25 years of experience delivering simulators to schools, law enforcement, military, and public safety organizations, Adiona-G brings professional-grade prevention training to standalone VR/AR.
